dialog.title: Create support bundle
dialog.intro: Vortex is packaging its log files, the current app state and any recent crash dumps into a single archive. No login details are included.
dialog.sendTo: Send the archive to the Vortex team, with a short description of the problem, in the Vortex forums or on Discord:
dialog.failed: Vortex could not build the support bundle.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Tell the Vortex team what happened. Your feedback is linked to your Nexus Mods account so the team can follow up.

choose.intro: How do you want to share your feedback?

send.title: Send it to the Vortex team
send.description: Write what happened and send it from here, with your support data and a screenshot if you want. It is linked to your Nexus Mods account.

logIn.description: Your login to Nexus Mods is from an older version of Vortex and can't be used to send feedback. Log in again, then choose Send feedback once more.

bundle.title: Create a support bundle
bundle.description: Save your logs, app state and crash dumps as a file on this computer, to share in the forums or on Discord.

supportData.label: Include support data
supportData.hint: Vortex's recent logs, the current app state and a summary of recent crashes. Usernames in file paths and login details are removed. Crash dump files stay on this computer.

logWindow.label: Logs to include
logWindow.hint: Choose a period that covers when the problem happened.

screenshot.label: Include a screenshot
screenshot.hint: A picture of the Vortex window, taken when you opened this dialog.
screenshot.alt: The screenshot that will be sent

replay.label: Include a recording of the last few minutes
replay.hint: Shows what happened in the Vortex window before you opened this dialog. Every piece of text in it is hidden, and pictures are left out.

feedback.sent: Thank you. Your feedback was sent to the Vortex team.
feedback.quoteId: Quote this ID if you contact the team about it
feedback.idKept: The ID stays in your notifications after you close this.

failed.unknown: Vortex could not send your feedback.
failed.unauthorized: Vortex could not send your feedback because your login was not accepted. Log in again, then send your feedback once more.
failed.rateLimited: You have sent a lot of feedback recently. Try again later.
failed.unavailable: Vortex could not reach Nexus Mods. Check your connection and try again.
failed.refused: The feedback service did not accept this feedback. Go back and send it without the support data, or create a support bundle instead.
